items.evidence: Log lines 2-193 show 18 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells with one tip.
Log shows 1 uL colony from each well to matching PCR well (lines 196+), then 1 uL primer from each well to matching PCR well (1156-1537) with the P20.
Every colony and every primer transfer has its own pick up/drop tip pair; single tip for master mix into empty wells is allowed.
protocol.comment at end records seal and the full program 98C 30 s; 30x[98/60/72]; 72C 2 min; hold 4C.
Steps follow the task order with 3x mix after colony dispense; comments are accurate and no invented steps; labels and pipettes as specified.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the simulator log for 18 uL master mix, 1 uL colony with 3x mixing, and 1 uL primer into all 96 wells. It uses fresh tips per sample and records the thermocycling comment accurately.
